paper.title: Providing visual analytics guidance through decision support

evidence.paraphrase: Proposes a generic method for providing visual-analytics guidance by framing guidance as a decision problem to help users reach analytical goals and insights.
Guidance in visual analytics is a named element of the knowledge-lens group purpose; the use case is clustering-method choice rather than rainfall.

reviews.rationale: The paper is a direct visual-analytics guidance method and fits knowledge_lens_guidance as defined. It does not touch rainfall evidence, but the group is method-side by design. As a valid representative of a group omitted from 30/150 final bags, it supports reading that omission as a genuine selection loss rather than a pool gap.

paper.title: Assessment of Satellite Products in Estimating Tropical Cyclone Remote Precipitation over the Yangtze River Delta Region

evidence.paraphrase: Evaluates CMORPH, TRMM and GPM satellite precipitation products for two typhoon-related heavy-rain events over the Yangtze River Delta using skill scores against gauges.
Touches spatial distribution, temporal distribution and peak detection of rainfall, which overlap the rainfall-pattern group's dimensions.
No knowledge lens, figure/table interpretation, Bangkok context or traceable-claim mechanism is described.

reviews.rationale: This is a satellite-product validation study for tropical-cyclone rainfall in China; it shares rainfall-pattern vocabulary but supplies no named method or evidence role for knowledge-guided interpretation of Bangkok rainfall evidence. Under the frozen scope note that generic hydrometeorological work is excluded unless it fills a named role, it is out of scope, though the boundary is debatable because the rainfall group is defined broadly.

paper.title: Data Provenance in Biomedical Research: Scoping Review

evidence.paraphrase: A PRISMA-ScR scoping review of 44 articles on software-based data-provenance management in biomedical research, covering capture, storage, retrieval, visualization and analysis.
Provenance supports reproducibility and auditable evidence, matching the provenance_traceability purpose.
It does not connect a knowledge or visual-analytic method to rainfall evidence or a specific traceable claim, which is what method_evidence_bridge requires.

reviews.rationale: The paper is legitimate provenance context but describes provenance infrastructure in biomedicine, not a bridge from a knowledge/visual method to empirical rainfall evidence. It belongs to provenance_traceability rather than method_evidence_bridge. If confirmed, the bridge group's omission from 97/150 bags is partly a construct-assignment issue rather than only a selection loss.

paper.title: Guided spiral visualization for periodic time series and residual analysis

evidence.paraphrase: Presents a guided analytical workflow around spiral visualization of periodic time series, with visual guidance and residual analysis leading to insights.
Includes a provenance dashboard that records all user interactions and supports comparing spirals.
Targets periodic patterns such as day-night rhythms in climate, traffic and energy data, which maps onto diurnal rainfall interpretation.

reviews.rationale: The paper is in scope and does contain a provenance mechanism, so provenance_traceability is partly justified, but its central contribution is visual guidance for periodic-pattern insight, closer to knowledge_lens_guidance, and it also bridges method and time-series evidence. The assignment is a partial rather than primary fit.

paper.title: Designing an Interactive Visual Analytics System for Precipitation Data Analysis

evidence.paraphrase: Designs an interactive visual analytics system with coordinated views for hourly precipitation across U.S. states, supporting temporal, spatial and statistical pattern analysis.
Links a visual-analytic method directly to empirical precipitation evidence (intensity, duration, frequency) via storm case studies.
The contribution is the VA system rather than rainfall-pattern findings, and the data are U.S. stations rather than Bangkok.

reviews.rationale: The paper connects a visual-analytics method to empirical precipitation evidence, which is the defining purpose of method_evidence_bridge; rainfall_pattern_evidence captures only its data side. It is in scope as method-to-evidence context, but the group label should probably be method_evidence_bridge.
